title: Contract Pricing Agreement Reviewed Escalation: Escalation Load Reduction
content:
Escalation load reduction — Contract Pricing Agreement

The load reduction follows the annual escalation lines on the agreement whose effective date is less than 12 whole months before the handling date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Annual escalation lines in the window | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 0.25 percentage point |
| At least one and fewer than 10 | 0.1 percentage point |
| None | Nothing taken off |

The points are taken off the reviewed escalation allowance — the lesser of the reviewed escalation increase and the tier's annual escalation cap — before the escalation line's prior unit price is raised by it, and the allowance never falls below 0.

Hypothetical example: four annual escalation lines effective within the window take 0.1 point off an allowance of 2.0 percent, leaving 1.9 percent.
